quantity: limiting relative slenderness of a flange outstand or flange plate
boundary_rule: Use 0.8 when member relative slenderness is below 0.8 and 4.0 when it is above 4.0.
classification_rule: The diagram group is selected by comparison with the diagrams printed in Table 10; automatic geometry classification is not provided.

group_1.visual_description: First diagram row, including I- and T-type flange outstands

group_2.visual_description: Second diagram row of open rolled/bent section outstands

group_3.visual_description: Third diagram row of angle-like outstands

group_4.visual_description: Fourth diagram row of the lipped/edge-return sections shown in the table

notes: The multipliers apply only to the equation groups explicitly named in the note to Table 10.
Clause 7.3.9 refers box-section flange plates back to Table 10 and defines their relative slenderness explicitly.
